# Objects with no unique index (generated)

<!-- GENERATED by tools/Generate-SchemaDocs.ps1 - do not edit by hand. -->

These objects have **no unique index**, so nothing constrains them to one row
per key. Joining to one can multiply your result set without warning - the
Cartesian product hazard this repo exists to guard against.

Views appear here routinely (a view inherits no index of its own); that is
expected and does not by itself mean the view is not one row per key.
Determine a view's grain from its underlying tables.
